Last Saturday, Tom and Lily went to the bus terminal. Lily is interested in dancing. The weather was cloudy that day. A sudden sickness kept her in bed all weekend.
Tom thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Tom spent the weekend at the zoo. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus terminal by bike. What's more, the business trip spans three cities.
Tom drinks tea after doing sports. The bus terminal is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like dumplings and tea. The tea merchant built this mansion.
Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Tom hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Lily's birthday is in October.
